none: PAS DEV-C2AA23: Roman coin Commodus as Caesar
contea di ritrovamento: Devon (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [IMP II/III COS II PP], S C

Roman copper-alloy sestertius of Commodus as Augustus under Marcus Aurelius (AD 177-180), dating to AD 179 (Reece Period 8). Mint of Rome in 179 AD. Obverse legend: ... COMMOD... Obverse type: Laureate head, right Reverse legend: [IMP II/III COS II PP], S C. Reverse type: Minerva standing left, dropping incense on altar and holding shield; spear against arm. RIC III p 342, nos. 1599/1607.…
